displayName: Write personalised outreach messages for a candidate shortlist
summary: Draft tailored InMails or emails for every candidate on your list in one pass.

useCases.title: Write personalised outreach messages for a candidate shortlist
useCases.message: Help me write outreach messages for a candidate shortlist. Ask me for the shortlist and what role I am hiring for. You might want to check what you know about my tone before drafting. Then research each candidate briefly and write a personalised message connecting their background to the opportunity.
